{
 "title": "Build and test candidate transform",
 "command": "cat > programs/task-27dd9ec6.py <<'PY'
def transform(grid):
    # Mirror the contents of each cell in the second panel row into the next row.
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Infer repeated divider rows/columns from the most frequent non-background color.
    sep = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda c: sum(row.count(c) for row in grid))
    rs = [r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == sep for v in row)]
    cs = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == sep for r in range(h))]
    rb = [-1] + rs + [h]
    cb = [-1] + cs + [w]
    # For each band, copy each nonempty cell vertically reflected into the band below.
    # This candidate handles equal-sized panels and leaves divider lines unchanged.
    for bi in range(1, len(rb)-2):
        r0,r1=rb[bi]+1,rb[bi+1]
        dr0,dr1=rb[bi+1]+1,rb[bi+2]
        for bj in range(len(cb)-1):
            c0,c1=cb[bj]+1,cb[bj+1]
            src=[row[c0:c1] for row in grid[r0:r1]]
            if len(src)==dr1-dr0 and all(v==0 or v==sep for row in src for v in row):
                continue
            if len(src)==dr1-dr0 and (dr1-dr0)==(r1-r0) and (c1-c0)>0:
                # Only copy into wholly empty destination cells.
                if all(grid[r][c]==0 for r in range(dr0,dr1) for c in range(c0,c1)):
                    for i in range(r1-r0):
                        for j in range(c1-c0):
                            out[dr0+i][c0+j]=grid[r1-1-i][c0+j]
    return out
PY
